mapper.select: SELECT oelrd.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, oelrd.event, oelrd.event_ltv, oelrd.user_ltv, oelrd.extra_type source_type, dui.create_time FROM ods_extra_ltv_record_diversion oelrd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = oelrd.user_id) WHERE oelrd.dates = #{dates}

SELECT dqlr.id, dqlr.dates, dqlr.user_id, dqlr.version, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.country, dqlr.event_ltv, dqlr.event, dqlr.user_ltv, dqlr.source_type, dqlr.create_time, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source, dui.dates register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, dui.dates, dqlr.dates) cohort_day FROM dwd_qp_ltv_record dqlr LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dqlr.user_id) LEFT JOIN dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = dqlr.user_id) where dqlr.dates = #{dates} and dqlr.id >= #{startId} and dqlr.id <= #{endId}
